hero.title: About
hero.body: A nonprofit restaurant with a simple idea: serve clean, fresh food and show that a restaurant can be environmentally responsible.
hero.imageAlt: A cook chopping fresh peppers on a cutting board

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.body: Kitchen33 is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit restaurant in Glen Allen, VA, owned and operated by American River Restoration. We serve clean, fresh food from a very clean kitchen: slow-smoked meats, desserts and sides made daily without preservatives, with water and air filtered to one micron or less.
mission.imageAlt: Illustrative storefront concept with a colorful mural and Kitchen33 sign

paragraphs.text: American River Restoration (A.R.R.) was formed in 2017 to clean up inland waterways, raise awareness about plastic pollution, prevent littering and promote environmental education.

In 2022, A.R.R. opened Kitchen33 on Mountain Road in Glen Allen to prove that a restaurant can be environmentally responsible and still succeed. We serve food in sugar cane and bamboo containers instead of Styrofoam, compost paper waste onsite for our garden, and donate leftover food to local families and individuals.
That same year, Kitchen33 won the Pie Insurance Upper Crust grand prize of $15,000, earmarked for an outdoor pavilion and river cleanup work.
